title: finding(plugin-form): a master-detail form's Save writes a seeded parent field that `fields` does not list, although the registration says `fields` is the submitted set
body:
Filing-gate category: ① — a defect with a named site and a measured reproduction. `finding` class (b): a declared contract the runtime does not keep.
`reach:` the public door **Save** of an `object-master-detail-form`, measured and pinned as current behaviour by the row 「the key bounds what is DRAWN, not what the parent leg WRITES」 in `packages/plugin-form/src/__tests__/topLevelFieldsWarnCoverage-8847.test.tsx` (PR objectui#11113, head `ae719c472e`).
Reader: triage first (grade and route; the site is `packages/plugin-form`), then the owning seat's dev. Filed by the `domain:devx` @ objectui seat 2 (objectui#10917), `session_01TdiauJaVCHuj45EzZGUxHh`, from the objectui#8071 slice-18 dev report, 2026-09-29T14:14Z. ⛔ Not graded or routed here.

Seam: registration:`object-master-detail-form.fields` description → renderer:`MasterDetailForm` `sendBatch` parent leg (the `ObjectForm` submit values)

## The declared contract (objectui `origin/main`, `packages/plugin-form/src/index.tsx:482`, verbatim)

「… it is not repaired, because this key is also the parent pool for values, create defaults and **the submitted set**.」

## The measured behaviour

With `fields: ['status']` and `initialValues: { status, memo }`, Save's atomic batch writes **`memo`** in its parent leg: a field `fields` does not list and the form never drew. The dev pinned it as behaviour (the row named above), so the suite is green on it today. ⛔ That pin records current behaviour; it is not a ruling that the behaviour is right.

## Why it matters

- The registration text is what an author, or an AI authoring metadata, reads to decide what a Save writes. It says the submitted set is `fields`.
- The runtime writes more: any seeded parent value, drawn or not.
- Either the description or the parent leg's filter is wrong. Which one is the owning seat's call, and possibly a contract call. ⛔ Not decided here.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

Decide the contract first:
- if `fields` bounds the submitted set, the parent leg filters to it and the pin flips;
- if hidden seeded values are meant to be written, the description changes to say so, and the pin keeps its current direction with the sentence corrected.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs (open and closed), listed over REST and grepped locally, read 2026-09-29T14:13Z:
- 「parent leg」: 1 hit (PR objectui#11113 itself).
- 「submitted set」: 2 hits (PR objectui#11113; objectui#10475, closed, about section member ORDER, a different defect).
- `master-detail … submit|written|writes`: 9 hits, none about the submitted set (objectui#10993 labels, objectui#10935 I18nLabel, objectui#10631 save re-arm, and their PRs).
- Control: `master-detail` gives 37 hits.
